## Change

Describe the scope and user-visible behavior. Link the related issue when available.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass
- [ ] The relevant platform build succeeds
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] UI changes are checked in both themes and at 100/150/200% scale
- [ ] Native Windows/macOS claims describe only behavior actually tested
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, raw server logs or unlicensed assets
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where needed

## Screenshots

Include before/after images for user-visible changes when practical.
